# Lusha

Skills that teach agents to work with Lusha. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [lusha-oss/lusha-mcp-plugin](https://github.com/lusha-oss/lusha-mcp-plugin), at commit `4bcf5c7`.

Connect Lusha to Claude to pull verified B2B data, contact data, and company data — including verified emails, direct dials, mobile numbers, and real-time buying signals — straight into your conversation.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Lusha**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Lusha**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install lusha@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

6 skills: `enrich-contact`, `lookalike-prospect`, `outreach-research`, `outreach-sequence`, `prospect`, `signal-prospect`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.
